name: Neoaves
blurb: Almost all living birds. Their early lineages split so rapidly, around the end-Cretaceous extinction, that their branching order is still debated.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), 95% credible interval
clock.data: Whole genomes of 363 species from 218 bird families
clock.checked: Stiller et al. 2024, main text ("Most Neoaves diversified post K–Pg")
clock.note: The split of Columbaves (here the pigeon) from the other sampled Neoaves. Crown Neoaves, including grebes and flamingos, which are not in this selection, is dated 67.4 Ma (66.2–68.9).
